//: Template for Vitorize.Api production configuration. Copy to appsettings.Production.json on the server (that file is git-ignored) or supply each value as an environment variable. Environment variables win over file values and use '__' for nesting, e.g. ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, Jwt__SecretKey, Encryption__Key. Never commit real values.

ConnectionStrings.//DefaultConnection: SQL Server connection string. SECRET - supply on the server.

Jwt.//SecretKey: Token signing key. SECRET - supply on the server. Rotating it invalidates all issued tokens.

Encryption.//Key: Key protecting encrypted columns (delivery codes, stored gateway/SMS credentials). SECRET - supply on the server. See the RC-01 report before rotating: existing encrypted rows must be re-encrypted.

BootstrapAdmin.//: One-time creation of the initial SuperAdmin. Enable, deploy, sign in, then set Enabled=false and clear these values.

Cors.//AllowedOrigins: Complete production origin list. The base appsettings.json ships an EMPTY array on purpose: .NET merges configuration arrays by index, so a non-empty base list would leak development origins into Production whenever this list is shorter. Never add localhost here.
